API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APISegment Group ManagementUpdate a Segment Group.
Update a Segment Group.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/:customerId/segmentGroup/:segmentGroupId

Update a Segment Group.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

segmentGroupId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Segment Group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
addedApps
int64[]
configSpace
string

Possible values: [DEFAULT, SIEM]

deletedApps
int64[]
description
string
enabled
boolean
microtenantId
int64
microtenantName
string
name
string
tcpKeepAliveEnabled
int32
